configuration_comparison.input_binding_scope: Audit/run SHA are bound to the original native gate; sim fingerprint/config files are separately captured here, not retroactively added to that gate.
limitations: Robot/EEF fingerprints cover recorded fields only, not complete physics state.
Different joint/quaternion or prompt hashes do not alone identify the cause of outcome changes.
Equal configuration/horizon does not prove identical installed runtime, model or initial scene state.
RoboLab final gallery slots are not paired reset seeds or per-slot decision-cap evidence.

recorded_initial_difference_inspection.scope: Numeric differences cover three recorded float32 robot fields only. Prompt comparison removes exactly the deployment directory line and preserves every other byte. Archived paths were normalized by the data exporter, so its prompt bytes need not have the prearchive run hash. Neither test proves identical original model input or explains changed outcomes.
recorded_initial_difference_inspection.input_binding_scope: Original numeric values come from previously SHA-verified core trajectories. Current initial NPZ and deployed prompt files are separately SHA captured and checked against recorded fingerprints/run prompt hash; no original native gate is rewritten.

limitations: 一对 RoboDojo layout4 改为预冻结 layout5；原面板另存，两个面板共享49对。
原RoboDojo Direct为48条原生完整轨迹加2条RPC超时前缀裁定失败；本次50条均原生完整，基础设施中断另行保留并有界重试。两个口径分列，不能据成功总数相同认定协议一致。
匹配案例ID与种子不能证明历史完整物理初态相同；RoboLab仅按任务汇总比较。
RoboLab Direct 使用自有 EEF 适配器，历史完整源码与prompt未恢复。
原 RoboLab 含历史结果及授权重试，两个 BlocksInBin Direct 重试使用500而非180决策；本次不采用该混合预算协议。
本次RoboLab日志的决策上限为100000，主要受原生控制时域约束；180/500决策表仅截看已有轨迹，不是新预算评测或因果解释。
Token 为控制器最后记录的累计计数，包含缓存输入；RoboLab缺少独立用量汇总，保持未知，不能作为零消耗或账单金额。
π0.5、Cosmos和DreamZero全量基线尚未纳入此前两方法范围。

historical_worker_fidelity.scope: Recorded rejection branches and initial model-preview bytes; exact historical source staging plus offline execution and zero-turn CLI initialization. Fresh physical canary is separate and has no new audited score here. Fifth-stop crossings are not counterfactual success estimates.
